description: You run toward the emergency. Now build a plan so money never becomes one. For most people, overtime is optional. For first responders, it quietly becomes the way life gets paid for. One shift for the bills. One shift to catch up. One shift that costs sleep, recovery, and time with the people you love. Financial Resiliency SOP Field Guide for First Responders gives you what you already trust on the job: clear procedures, simple flowcharts, and a plan you can follow even on your most exhausted day. Chris Harcksen-Lucero has worked in EMS since 1987 and as a flight paramedic since 2006. She is also a Certified YNAB Coach. She built this guide for the real life of 12s, 24s, nights, holidays, mandatory OT, and the stress no one else sees. Think of her as your Financial FTO. She won't do it for you, but she will walk alongside you while you build it. Inside you'll find: SOPs for knowing your numbers, building a spending plan (not a budget), and stopping surprise bills The Overtime Decision flowchart: should I take this shift? How to handle mandatory OT so the money has a job before it's spent How to break the OT Trap when your base pay no longer covers your life Debt payoff methods, and how to tell if you're living on the Credit Card Float Why your pension is a foundation, not the whole plan Insurance, wills, and line-of-duty final wishes, with a fill-in Personal Protection Plan Quick Guides for buying a car or home, raises, windfalls, divorce, marriage, and stress spending Each SOP gives you the objective, the procedure, common errors, and when to call for help. No lectures and no jargon. You get a system that still works when you're running on no sleep. title: The Single Mom's Playbook: A Financial Strategies and Emotional Resiliency Guidelines
description: Are you a single mother drowning in financial stress, emotional exhaustion, and the constant pressure of doing it all alone? You are not alone. You are not failing. You are simply overwhelmed by a system that was not built for you. This book is your lifeline. It is a practical, step by step blueprint designed specifically for single mothers who want to take control of their money, calm their anxiety, and build a stable future for themselves and their children. No vague advice. No judgment. Just actionable strategies that work. The Single Mom's Playbook delivers thirty powerful chapters that tackle every area of your life. You will learn how to create a zero based budget that accounts for every dollar. You will build an emergency fund that protects you from unexpected crises. You will eliminate debt using proven methods tailored to your psychology. You will expand your income and advance your career even while managing the demands of parenting. You will master child care, housing, transportation, and grocery costs. You will navigate health care, legal protections, and credit repair. This is not a theoretical guide. This is a hands on manual for real life. Beyond the financial strategies, this book addresses the emotional weight you carry. You will learn to regulate your stress, set powerful boundaries, and practice self compassion. You will build a social network that supports you. You will develop a coparenting communication system that reduces conflict. You will understand your child's developmental needs and create connection rituals that strengthen your bond. You will integrate fun and play into your family life. You will build resilience that helps you bounce back from any setback. This is holistic guidance for the whole woman, not just the bank account. title: PROTECT YOUR FAMILY AND WEALTH: A Practical Guide to Financial Resilience, Crisis Prepared
description: What would happen to your family’s finances if your income suddenly stopped, prices surged, markets fell, or a major disruption changed everyday life? PROTECT YOUR FAMILY AND WEALTH is a practical guide to financial resilience, crisis preparedness, and protecting your savings in an uncertain world. Financial security is about more than how much you earn or own. It is about having a plan, maintaining access to essential resources, and making informed decisions when unexpected events put pressure on your household. INSIDE THIS BOOK, YOU WILL LEARN HOW TO: Prepare for economic uncertainty: Understand how geopolitical tensions, energy disruptions, supply-chain problems, inflation, and market volatility can affect household finances. Build a stronger financial foundation: Review essential expenses, manage debt, strengthen emergency savings, and prepare for possible income interruptions. Protect your savings and purchasing power: Understand the trade-offs involving cash, bonds, stocks, gold, real estate, and digital assets. Reduce financial vulnerabilities: Examine liquidity needs, insurance coverage, investment concentration, and access to important financial records. Prepare your household: Organize essential supplies, emergency contacts, financial documents, and family communication procedures. Make more disciplined decisions: Separate credible evidence from speculation and avoid allowing fear or alarming headlines to dictate financial choices. Follow a practical 30-day plan: Identify weaknesses, prioritize improvements, and begin building a more resilient household. WHY THIS APPROACH MATTERS You do not need to predict every crisis to prepare for uncertainty. This is not simply a book about money. It is a book about how to remain whole when money is under pressure . Inside, readers will learn how to stabilize themselves emotionally before making major financial decisions, protect the essentials of the household, communicate with dignity during family stress, seek help early, manage debt wisely, understand bankruptcy and restructuring options, defend income in a changing economy, and prepare for future disruptions caused by inflation, artificial intelligence, automation, monetary debasement, market instability, and rapid technological change. With the right mindset, the right plan, the right support, and the courage to face reality early, pressure can become a doorway into greater wisdom, discipline, sovereignty, and resilience. description: What if the money you already have could become the starting point for something more? Carolyn Mowat knew how to budget. After raising eleven children and making one income stretch as far as possible, careful money management had become a way of life. But when she and her husband took an honest look at their retirement savings, one question changed everything: Will this really be enough? That question began a journey into investing, financial education and a very different way of thinking about money. Creating Overflow shares the lessons Carolyn learned along the way—including the mistakes. Written for ordinary people who may feel that investing is confusing, risky or simply “not for people like me,” it explains financial ideas in straightforward language without promising shortcuts or guaranteed results. You'll explore: • why saving and growing money are not the same thing • how small amounts can become useful starting points • the importance of stewardship, diversification and managing risk • what Carolyn learned from both successful and unsuccessful investments • cryptocurrency and AI without the hype or fear • the Creating Overflow™ Framework—a stepped approach in which one opportunity can help create the next • practical questions, safety principles and checklists to help you think more carefully before investing Creating Overflow isn't about getting rich quickly or finding one perfect investment. It's about learning to make thoughtful decisions, protect what you're building and gradually create greater financial resilience. You don't need to know everything before you begin.
